declaredParameters.rule: A vertex is removed where it is the same point as the vertex before it, or where it is the tip of a zero-width spike: the outline goes out along a line and comes straight back along it, so the three vertices are collinear and the path reverses. Neither changes the area any outline encloses. Every other vertex is kept as published.
declaredParameters.order: Ring by ring, in the order published. First every vertex equal in both coordinates to the vertex before it in the published ring is removed. Then, on the ring without its closing vertex, read cyclically: the first i where c lies on segment ab or a lies on segment bc, for a, b, c the vertices at i, i+1, i+2, removes b; repeated from the start until none is found or 3 vertices are left. The ring is closed again with its first vertex.
declaredParameters.onSegment: p lies on segment ab where |(b-a) x (p-a)| < 1e-12 and each coordinate of p is within the bounding box of a and b widened by 1e-12, in degrees.
declaredParameters.recorded: Each removal as {kind: repeated|spike, at: [x, y]}, in the order made.
